description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, which extends Entity Framework Core's DbContext to configure and manage database access for the application's domain entities. It includes DbSet properties for entities like Article, Comment, Person, Tag, and relationship entities. The class also handles model creation with specific key and foreign key configurations, as well as transaction management methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: An Entity Framework Core DbContext subclass managing domain entities and database relationships, including transaction handling.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active, using an appropriate transaction isolation level.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current active transaction, with exception handling to rollback if commit fails.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current active transaction if one exists, ensuring resources are freed.
